step.name: HWDB entry and runtime configuration
step.description: Create the HWDB entry in deploy/config_hwdb.yaml referencing the V80 bitstream (PDI) and design metadata. Create a V80-specific runtime config section or a sample run-farm recipe YAML that sets default_platform to XilinxAlveoV80InstanceDeployManager. The build recipe already exists in config_build_recipes.yaml (xilinx_alveo_v80_firesim_rocket_singlecore_no_nic). The HWDB entry should reference the PDI path and driver tar from a successful buildbitstream run. For initial setup, a placeholder entry pointing to the debug PDI (cl_firesim_debug/vivado_proj/firesim_debug.pdi) is acceptable.
success_criteria: HWDB entry exists in config_hwdb.yaml with valid bitstream path, design config, and platform metadata
Runtime config YAML exists with default_platform set to XilinxAlveoV80InstanceDeployManager
firesim managerinit accepts the config without parse errors
Config files reference consistent design names across build recipes, HWDB, and runtime config

parts.description: Register V80 platform in firesim managerinit dispatch. Add 'xilinx_alveo_v80' to the elif condition on line 187 of $FIRESIM/deploy/firesim (append `or args.platform == 'xilinx_alveo_v80'` to the existing elif chain). Add `'xilinx_alveo_v80': 'XilinxAlveoV80InstanceDeployManager'` to the deploy_manager_map dict on lines 194-200 of the same file. The elif condition currently reads: `elif args.platform == 'vitis' or args.platform == 'xilinx_alveo_u250' or args.platform == 'xilinx_alveo_u280' or args.platform == 'xilinx_alveo_u200' or args.platform == 'xilinx_vcu118' or args.platform == 'rhsresearch_nitefury_ii' or args.platform == 'corigine_xb10':` — append `or args.platform == 'xilinx_alveo_v80'`. The deploy_manager_map currently ends with `'corigine_xb10': 'CorigineXB10InstanceDeployManager',` — add `'xilinx_alveo_v80': 'XilinxAlveoV80InstanceDeployManager',` after it. The XilinxAlveoV80InstanceDeployManager class already exists in $FIRESIM/deploy/runtools/run_farm_deploy_managers.py (line 1447). The PLATFORM_LIST argparse choices are dynamically generated from the platforms/ directory, so no argparse changes are needed.
parts.done_when: firesim managerinit --platform xilinx_alveo_v80 output does NOT contain 'Unknown platform xilinx_alveo_v80. Skipping default config overrides.' and instead shows the run_farm recipe being applied (look for 'Adding default overrides to config files' without the 'Unknown platform' message). After running managerinit, verify config_runtime.yaml contains 'XilinxAlveoV80InstanceDeployManager' by running: grep 'XilinxAlveoV80InstanceDeployManager' /home/ray/chipyard/sims/firesim/deploy/config_runtime.yaml

parts.description:
Create a placeholder bitstream tarball from the debug PDI and add the V80 HWDB entry to config_hwdb.yaml. Step A: Create the tarball. The build system packages bitstreams as tar.gz files containing a platform-named directory with the bitstream and a metadata file. The metadata format is a comma-separated key:value string (parsed by firesim_description_to_tags in $FIRESIM/deploy/awstools/afitools.py). Create a staging directory, populate it, and tar it:

  STAGING=/home/ray/chipyard/sims/firesim/deploy/built-hwdb-entries/xilinx_alveo_v80_firesim_rocket_singlecore_no_nic
  mkdir -p $STAGING/xilinx_alveo_v80
  cp /home/ray/chipyard/sims/firesim/platforms/xilinx_alveo_v80/cl_firesim_debug/vivado_proj/firesim_debug.pdi $STAGING/xilinx_alveo_v80/firesim.pdi
  echo 'firesim-buildquintuplet:xilinx_alveo_v80-firesim-FireSim-FireSimRocket8GiBDRAMConfig-BaseXilinxAlveoV80Config,firesim-deployquintuplet:xilinx_alveo_v80-firesim-FireSim-FireSimRocket8GiBDRAMConfig-BaseXilinxAlveoV80Config,firesim-buildtriplet:FireSim-FireSimRocket8GiBDRAMConfig-BaseXilinxAlveoV80Config,firesim-deploytriplet:FireSim-FireSimRocket8GiBDRAMConfig-BaseXilinxAlveoV80Config,firesim-commit:placeholder,firesim-buildmakefrag:None,firesim-deploymakefrag:None' > $STAGING/xilinx_alveo_v80/metadata
  cd $STAGING && tar czf firesim.tar.gz xilinx_alveo_v80/

Step B: Add the HWDB entry to config_hwdb.yaml. Note: Part 1's managerinit may have overwritten config_hwdb.yaml with the sample (containing only midasexamples_gcd). Append the V80 entry AFTER the sample entry (after the '# DOCREF END: Example HWDB Entry' line):

  xilinx_alveo_v80_firesim_rocket_singlecore_no_nic:
      bitstream_tar: file:///home/ray/chipyard/sims/firesim/deploy/built-hwdb-entries/xilinx_alveo_v80_firesim_rocket_singlecore_no_nic/firesim.tar.gz
      deploy_quintuplet_override: null
      custom_runtime_config: null

The entry name MUST match the build recipe name in config_build_recipes.yaml: 'xilinx_alveo_v80_firesim_rocket_singlecore_no_nic'. The custom_runtime_config field is REQUIRED (accessed via dict[] not .get() in RuntimeHWConfig.__init__ at line 286 of runtime_config.py).
parts.build_command: cd /home/ray/chipyard/sims/firesim/deploy && python3 -c "import yaml; data = yaml.safe_load(open('config_hwdb.yaml')); entry = data['xilinx_alveo_v80_firesim_rocket_singlecore_no_nic']; assert 'bitstream_tar' in entry; assert 'custom_runtime_config' in entry; print('HWDB entry parsed OK:', entry)" && test -f /home/ray/chipyard/sims/firesim/deploy/built-hwdb-entries/xilinx_alveo_v80_firesim_rocket_singlecore_no_nic/firesim.tar.gz && echo 'Tarball exists' && tar tzf /home/ray/chipyard/sims/firesim/deploy/built-hwdb-entries/xilinx_alveo_v80_firesim_rocket_singlecore_no_nic/firesim.tar.gz | head -5
parts.done_when: Python YAML parsing succeeds with output showing 'HWDB entry parsed OK' with bitstream_tar and custom_runtime_config keys present. The tarball file exists and tar listing shows xilinx_alveo_v80/firesim.pdi and xilinx_alveo_v80/metadata.

parts.description:
Update config_runtime.yaml to reference the V80 HWDB entry and deploy manager, then validate end-to-end consistency. After Part 1 runs managerinit, the runtime config's run_farm section will already have 'default_platform: XilinxAlveoV80InstanceDeployManager' (set by managerinit). But the target_config section still has 'default_hw_config: midasexamples_gcd' from the sample template. Update this to 'xilinx_alveo_v80_firesim_rocket_singlecore_no_nic' to match the HWDB entry from Part 2.

Modify $FIRESIM/deploy/config_runtime.yaml:
  - In the target_config section (~line 36), change:
      default_hw_config: midasexamples_gcd
    to:
      default_hw_config: xilinx_alveo_v80_firesim_rocket_singlecore_no_nic

Also verify these consistency checks pass:
  1. The HWDB entry name ('xilinx_alveo_v80_firesim_rocket_singlecore_no_nic') exists in both config_hwdb.yaml AND config_build_recipes.yaml
  2. The deploy manager class ('XilinxAlveoV80InstanceDeployManager') in config_runtime.yaml matches the class name in runtools/run_farm_deploy_managers.py
  3. The PLATFORM field in config_build_recipes.yaml ('xilinx_alveo_v80') matches the PLATFORM_NAME in the deploy manager class
  4. The default_hw_config in config_runtime.yaml matches the HWDB entry name
parts.build_command:
cd /home/ray/chipyard/sims/firesim/deploy && python3 -c "
import yaml

# Parse all config files
hwdb = yaml.safe_load(open('config_hwdb.yaml'))
recipes = yaml.safe_load(open('config_build_recipes.yaml'))
runtime = yaml.safe_load(open('config_runtime.yaml'))

# Check 1: HWDB entry name exists
entry_name = 'xilinx_alveo_v80_firesim_rocket_singlecore_no_nic'
assert entry_name in hwdb, f'{entry_name} not in config_hwdb.yaml'
assert entry_name in recipes, f'{entry_name} not in config_build_recipes.yaml'
print(f'CHECK 1 PASS: {entry_name} in both HWDB and build recipes')

# Check 2: default_hw_config matches HWDB entry
hw_config = runtime['target_config']['default_hw_config']
assert hw_config == entry_name, f'default_hw_config {hw_config} != {entry_name}'
print(f'CHECK 2 PASS: default_hw_config = {hw_config}')

# Check 3: deploy manager in runtime config
platform = runtime['run_farm']['recipe_arg_overrides']['default_platform']
assert platform == 'XilinxAlveoV80InstanceDeployManager', f'default_platform = {platform}'
print(f'CHECK 3 PASS: default_platform = {platform}')

# Check 4: PLATFORM in build recipe matches deploy manager
assert recipes[entry_name]['PLATFORM'] == 'xilinx_alveo_v80'
print('CHECK 4 PASS: build recipe PLATFORM = xilinx_alveo_v80')

print('ALL CONSISTENCY CHECKS PASSED')
"
parts.done_when: The Python validation script prints 'ALL CONSISTENCY CHECKS PASSED' showing: (1) HWDB entry name exists in both config_hwdb.yaml and config_build_recipes.yaml, (2) default_hw_config in config_runtime.yaml matches the HWDB entry name, (3) default_platform is XilinxAlveoV80InstanceDeployManager, (4) build recipe PLATFORM matches.
